steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ's Participants tab without recreating or searching for the event.
Enable per-vendor price caps required by the case.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled as required by the case.
Add a cap of 100 for the first eligible invited vendor, corresponding to Vendor A in the prepared state.
Verify that the saved cap is 100 for the selected vendor.
Switch to the available invited vendor's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the prepared RFQ's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify that the capped vendor's quote above 100 is refused.
